about: All weapons in theHunter: Call of the Wild as of Patch 9.3 / Old West Weapon Pack (Sept 2026), with ammo and the animal class range each ammo is rated for. In the game the ammo, not the weapon, determines the harvest-check class.
notes: classRange on a weapon = union of its ammo ranges. Magazine counts are from community guides (DLC Weapon Guide, NamuWiki, IMFDB) and can differ from official copy (e.g. Hunter Power Pack page says 5-round magazines). Prices marked 'in-game' are store cash, from a 2026 community guide. Base-game handgun ammo (.357, .44 revolver) class ranges were not verifiable. Penetration/expansion numbers were only found for two loads. Weapon names follow official pages where available; skin variants (Gamekeeper 12G, Grankin's Shotgun, Sundberg 454, .44 Gaucho, etc.) are noted, not listed separately. Animal classes were standardised in Update 1.81 (March 2024); older class charts predate that.
